tools.name: get_law_texts
tools.description: When calculated_current is present, use its text_ar for current monetary amounts and cite its authority.url. Identify this as calculated under the authority, never as verbatim published wording. The article text_ar and source fields remain published wording. Get the verbatim texts of a law's article

tools.name: get_ruling
tools.description: Get one court ruling (judgment) by id: court, number, date, panel, and its verbatim text when the Centre holds it as typed text. When available, pages returns the scanned judgment's machine reading, with low_confidence: true on hard-to-read pages where errors are expected. pdf_url is the full judgme

tools.name: get_gazette_issue
tools.description: Get one Official Gazette issue by id: its number, publication date, and the laws, decrees and decisions it published. Not legal advice.

tools.name: get_links
tools.description: Get the graph edges into or out of one item: a law, an article, a ruling, an opinion, a research study or a Gazette issue. Use this to walk citations and amendments directly, instead of only what get_law and get_article attach automatically. For a law key ("law/<id>") the default scope "all" include

tools.name: list_legislation
tools.description: List laws, decrees and decisions by date, newest first: for "everything published since January 2025" call with since "2025-01". The date is the publication date: the Official Gazette date, else the issue date (each entry's date, with gazette_number, gazette_date and gazette_issue_id). Recent texts

tools.name: possibly_affected
tools.description: Get the general repeals that may touch a law: earlier texts with a "all provisions contrary to this law are repealed" clause pointing at it. A list to check, never a finding that anything was actually repealed. Not legal advice.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "search_legislation" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
